P094.title: Investigating the effect of under-block rubber pad damping on the vibrational elastic support block ballastless track: an energy dissipation perspective
P094.authors: B Peng, Z Li, X He, L Xu
P094.label: Peng等（2025）

complete_examples.text: When bc =2.0×104 Ns/m, the energy dissipation capacity of the rail pad is close to that of the block pad, whereas the energy dissipation capacity of the block pad significantly grows with the increase of block pad damping, which indicates that the block pad dissipates the most of the vibration energy excited by moving vehicle.
A novel finite element-based energy dissipation formulation is proposed for efficient vibration energy computation in ESB tracks.
